organization.name: Deep Thought Marketing
organization.description: DeepThought is a done-for-you digital advertising service for small and medium businesses. We plan, buy, launch and manage ads across 22 advertising products. Our AI recommends the channels, budget and audiences, drafts the ads and writes plain-English reports; our team runs the media. It costs a fraction of a comparable agency retainer.
organization.slogan: Better ads. Fraction of the cost.

pricing.summary: Per-product pricing, month to month with no contract, at a fraction of what a comparable agency retainer costs. Media is covered inside the price rather than billed on top, and there is no percentage-of-spend management fee. Budgets of any size can start; Deep Thought recommends the media mix that fits the budget, and the figure for a given business comes from a short call rather than a published rate card.

tiers.name: Starting Off
tiers.description: Paid search, shopping and local service ads, programmatic display and retargeting, YouTube Performance Max. Unlimited campaign launches, continuous creative and bid optimization, monthly reporting.

tiers.name: Full funnel
tiers.description: Search, social, video and display run as one connected plan. Cross-channel budget reallocation, named marketing expert, CRM and POS revenue attribution, weekly reporting.

tiers.name: Multi-Location / Enterprise
tiers.description: For brands and franchise systems running many markets. Per-location campaigns and budgets, brand controls and approval flows, roll-up and per-store reporting, user management by role. Quoted custom.

faq.q: How fast can I launch a campaign?
faq.a: As soon as possible. Once your accounts are set up, Deep Thought's AI recommends the channels, budget and audiences and drafts the ads, so there is no weeks-long production queue.

faq.q: What kinds of businesses use DeepThought?
faq.a: Small and medium businesses running their own paid media — services, retail, healthcare, home services — from one location to a few dozen.

faq.q: Does Deep Thought manage campaigns after launch?
faq.a: Yes. Optimization, budget reallocation, creative refreshes, and reporting continue for as long as the campaign runs. You approve the direction; it does the work.
No. Month to month, cancel any time.

Pricing is per product and month to month, and it works out to a fraction of what a comparable agency retainer costs. Your media is covered inside the price rather than billed on top, and there is no percentage-of-spend management fee. What you pay depends on which products you run, so the number comes from a short call rather than a rate card — budgets of any size can get started, and Deep Thought recommends the media mix that fits yours.

No. DeepThought is a platform that performs the execution work an agency would — creative, targeting, channel mix, optimization, reporting — without a retainer or a briefing cycle. A human expert is available when you want one.
